_comment: For AI agents: create works in array order. Each work requires title, opensAt and dueAt as local YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm (24-hour clock, no offset) within the subject's September-August academic year, with dueAt later than opensAt. subject is an accessible subject ID; omit only with a subject filter selected. The work itself has an optional unique id. Omit it to generate a UUID automatically, as in the UI. The subject field identifies the course and taskId identifies an attached bank task; both links work even if the work has no explicit id. sequential controls linear unlocking; review requires teacher confirmation. activities are ordered: use {taskId} for an existing same-subject bank task, kind=program for an inline task (same fields as tasks-template.json; also added to the bank), or kind=quiz. Quiz attempts, threshold and timer minutes are positive integers. threshold cannot exceed question count; timer=whole uses quiz minutes, timer=question uses question minutes and requires back=false. shuffle controls answer order. Each question needs a Markdown prompt and at least one correct answer. A work may have no activities. The example references arrays, a built-in task in cpp.
